skills.name: Issue analysis
skills.instructions: Summarize expected and actual behavior, reproduction steps and acceptance criteria from the selected GitHub issue.
skills.outputContract: A concise summary, typed observed/hypothesis/proposal findings, valid source citations and explicit uncertainties.

skills.name: Repository navigation
skills.instructions: Read the selected issue, locate relevant modules in the pinned tree and inspect source before explaining responsibilities. Start with source paths mentioned by the issue or upstream report.
skills.outputContract: A concise summary, typed observed/hypothesis/proposal findings, valid source citations and explicit uncertainties.

skills.name: Change impact analysis
skills.instructions: Inspect source related to the issue. Explain directly affected files, plausible downstream effects and proposed changes. Source claims need inspected file evidence; mark unverified dependency effects as hypotheses.
skills.outputContract: A concise summary, typed observed/hypothesis/proposal findings, valid source citations and explicit uncertainties.

skills.name: Regression test planning
skills.instructions: Use upstream issue and source-impact findings to propose concrete regression tests, edge cases and expected outcomes. Do not claim tests were run.
skills.outputContract: A concise summary, typed observed/hypothesis/proposal findings, valid source citations and explicit uncertainties.

skills.name: Compatibility and risk review
skills.instructions: Review upstream findings for compatibility risks, uncertainty, incomplete coverage and unsupported assumptions.
skills.outputContract: A concise summary, typed observed/hypothesis/proposal findings, valid source citations and explicit uncertainties.

skills.name: Repository release briefing
skills.instructions: Summarize recent repository releases and flag relevant compatibility changes. State when the source does not establish relevance to the issue.
skills.outputContract: A concise summary, typed observed/hypothesis/proposal findings, valid source citations and explicit uncertainties.

skills.name: RSS analysis
skills.instructions: Summarize recent feed items, identify themes and preserve source links. Distinguish facts from inferred relevance.
skills.outputContract: A concise summary, typed observed/hypothesis/proposal findings, valid source citations and explicit uncertainties.

skills.name: Hacker News analysis
skills.instructions: Summarize the retrieved stories and discussion metadata. Explain potential engineering relevance as inference, preserving links and uncertainty.
skills.outputContract: A concise summary, typed observed/hypothesis/proposal findings, valid source citations and explicit uncertainties.

skills.name: Evidence review
skills.instructions: Audit upstream findings against retrieved evidence. Identify unsupported claims, incomplete retrieval and uncertain file impact. Cite inherited evidence; do not invent facts.
skills.outputContract: A concise summary, typed observed/hypothesis/proposal findings, valid source citations and explicit uncertainties.

skills.name: Combined briefing
skills.instructions: Combine completed upstream findings into a coherent engineering report. Include issue summary, affected files, proposed changes, tests, risks and uncertainty when provided. Separate repository evidence from broader news context.
skills.outputContract: A concise summary, typed observed/hypothesis/proposal findings, valid source citations and explicit uncertainties.
